info.name: Meralot Merchants Admin API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Meralot Merchants Admin Backend.

**Setup:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your server base URL (e.g. `http://localhost:3000/api`).
2. After a successful login, copy the returned `token` and set it as the `jwt` collection variable.
3. All protected routes automatically inherit the `Authorization: Bearer {{jwt}}` header.

item.name: 🔍 Identity Verification Providers
item.description:
CRUD management for identity verification providers (Persona, Sumsub, Onfido, etc.).
Mounted at /admin/identity-providers.
All endpoints require a valid admin JWT cookie.

request.description: Create a new identity verification provider. The `apiKey` is encrypted at rest and never returned in plain text. `priorityUS` is required when `isUSProvider=true`; `priorityNonUS` is required when `isNonUSProvider=true`.

response.name: 201 Created
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 201,
  "message": "Identity verification provider created successfully",
  "data": {
    "_id": "{{identityProviderId}}",
    "name": "Persona",
    "apiKeyMasked": "***...here",
    "templateId": { "US": "tmpl_us_kyc_v2", "GB": "tmpl_gb_kyc_v1", "default": "tmpl_global_kyc" },
    "isUSProvider": true,
    "isNonUSProvider": true,
    "priorityUS": 1,
    "priorityNonUS": 2,
    "isActive": true,
    "health": { "status": "healthy", "manualOverride": false },
    "notSupportedCountries": [{ "code": "CN", "reason": "Not licensed" }, "RU"],
    "environment": "sandbox"
  }
}

response.name: 400 Duplicate Name

request.description: Partial update — only supplied fields are changed. If `apiKey` is included it is re-encrypted. Setting `isActive=false` does not cancel in-progress verifications.
Supply only `apiKey` to rotate the credential. The new key is encrypted at rest via the pre-save hook; the previous key is discarded.
Soft-delete: sets `isActive=false` and records `deletedAt`. Returns 409 if the provider has active (pending/in_progress/awaiting_result) verification tasks.

response.name: 409 Conflict — Active Tasks

request.description: Manually set provider health status. When `manualOverride=true`, automated health-check jobs will not overwrite this status. Set `manualOverride=false` to release the lock back to automated checks.

response.name: 200 OK — Lock health
